unit: teacher-correct theorem; manual descriptive mathematical analysis of final response, not kernel proof judgment
criteria: same_method means main proof architecture (not same statement, token-level identity, proof correctness or mathematical equivalence). Consequential insight use requires an explicit mathematical operation in solution rather than mere copying into insight metadata. Numeric answer correctness separately exact checked.

markov.teacher: Vieta descent and exhaustive bounded reverse tree

baseline.diagnosis: Correct involution, incorrect descent algebra/endpoints, incomplete enumeration and wrong count.

insight.diagnosis: Involution and attempted improved descent, but incomplete and incorrect reverse-tree enumeration.

control.diagnosis: Correct involution; incorrectly restricts tree to a chain and counts only three.

pattern_race.teacher: Equal expected stopped gambler payouts using overlaps

baseline.diagnosis: Uses prefix automaton, erroneous transition equations.

insight.diagnosis: Disregards gambler construction, uses incorrect automaton.

control.diagnosis: Automaton method with unstated equation solve and wrong fraction.

cyclic_words.teacher: Alternating runs, correct feasible k and marked-run counting

baseline.diagnosis: Derives correct count expression but wrong binomial evaluations, answer field inconsistent with derivation.

insight.diagnosis: Same count expression but incorrect feasible k and arithmetic.

control.diagnosis: Run decomposition but falsely forces exactly eight runs.

grid_trees.teacher: Matrix-tree theorem, Cartesian-product spectra and exact path polynomial

insight.diagnosis: Correct eigenvalue product formula; repeats erroneous 2415.

baseline.diagnosis: Attempts reflection/inclusion-exclusion but invalid segment count and claims paths cannot pass both forbidden vertices.

insight.diagnosis: Uses supplied general starting-height formula but swaps coordinate step counts and computes inconsistent values.
